skills.name: caveman
skills.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by dropping filler, articles, and pleasantries while keeping full technical accuracy. Use when user says 'caveman mode', 'less tokens', 'be brief', or invokes /caveman.
skills.author: nitesh000

skills.name: diagnose
skills.description: Disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Reproduce → minimise → hypothesise → instrument → fix → regression-test. Use when user says 'diagnose this', 'debug this', reports a bug, or describes a performance regression.
skills.author: nitesh000

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Test-driven development with red-green-refactor loop. Use when user wants to build features or fix bugs using TDD, mentions 'red-green-refactor', wants integration tests, or asks for test-first development.
skills.author: nitesh000

skills.name: write-a-skill
skills.description: Create new agent skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and bundled resources. Use when user wants to create, write, or build a new skill.
skills.author: nitesh000

bundles.name: nitesh000/skill-set
bundles.description: Core productivity skills — caveman, diagnose, tdd, write-a-skill
bundles.author: nitesh000
